pricing.title: Sell on Servbo for free.
pricing.intro: Becoming a seller costs nothing: every {days} days you get {free, plural, one {# free credit} other {# free credits}}. Publishing a product costs {publish, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} and saving changes to a published product costs {edit, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}}. Drafts are free. Need more? Buy a credit pack by scanning a QR code: paid credits never expire and are spent after the free ones.
pricing.introDefault: Becoming a seller costs nothing: every {days} days you get free credits. Publishing a product costs a credit and saving changes to a published product costs a credit. Drafts are free. Need more? Buy a credit pack by scanning a QR code: paid credits never expire and are spent after the free ones.

becomeSeller.title: Open your store on Servbo for free.
becomeSeller.intro: Becoming a seller costs nothing. Every {days} days you get {count, plural, one {# free credit} other {# free credits}} to publish and update your products: they reset each cycle and don't carry over. When you need more, credit packs add paid credits that never expire and add up. Free credits are always spent first. You manage your products from the creator app.
